name: Drawing
description: Draw the answer: a diagram, a timeline, an equation. Graded by a vision model, or rated by you.
instructions: The answer is a hand drawing made with a mouse or pen, so lines are rough and handwriting is messy. Judge the content: the structure, labels, order and relationships the reference describes. Ignore neatness. Read handwriting generously; if a label is truly illegible, treat it as missing.
